title: Chapter 35: Surrounding Information
content:
Chapter 35: Surrounding Information

In the past two days, Wu Qing, in addition to resettling the refugees and planning and building a new city, had another very important matter that he had been paying close attention to.

That was the information collected by the puppies who secretly followed various refugee teams to various territories.

A group of two puppies secretly followed a team of refugees to the territories surrounding Daxia Territory.

Except for a few refugee teams that were unlucky and had accidents, the other refugee teams all arrived safely at their destinations.

Wu Qing saw the strange and terrifying world at night through the perspective of a puppy who was tracking a group of refugees who had an unexpected incident.

These refugee teams basically missed the time due to various reasons and did not arrive at the destination territory as scheduled, resulting in spending the night in the wild.

As night falls, a terrifying atmosphere surrounds these refugees, with various frightening scenes. The refugees enjoy the ultimate horror package before finally dying in various ways.

Some people were scared to death.

The changes that occurred after the refugees died were also different. Some turned into strange, polluted and twisted monsters, some disappeared directly, and some Wu Qing didn't know what happened.

The puppies who followed these refugees ended up suddenly losing contact. With luck, they killed a few strange creatures and earned some money.

"We can't touch this weird thing for now. We'll talk about it when it becomes stronger."

Wu Qing has always had the dangerous idea of gathering more weird wool, but now he can only give up.

The other puppies have entered the sixteen territories in the north of the Great Xia Territory. These territories are the territories closest to the territory of destruction. In fact, the destinations of many tributary people are the same.

The puppies wandered around in these territories for a while, then burrowed and lurked in the lord's sanctuary area of each territory.

The lord's protection can prevent strange invasions, but it will not affect ordinary creatures. It is not surprising that some strange creatures are lurking in various territories.

Whether a territory can effectively defend against enemies other than weird ones depends on the strength of each territory.

After the puppy's preliminary reconnaissance, it was found that these sixteen territories are large and small. The large territory can accommodate tens of thousands of people. The small territory is like a small village, with a population of less than a thousand people. It is larger than the original Daxia territory. Even more pitiful.

These territories will be the first line of attack against the bugbears, and they are the focus of Wu Qing's attention.

If these territories are all breached by the enemy, the Daxia Territory will be almost surrounded by the enemy, and will have to fight the enemy alone from now on.

This is not what Wu Qing wants to see.

"It seems that from now on, I have to put some thought into guarding the gates of these territories every day. If there are enemies, help fight them back first!"

"I hope we can temporarily divert the attention of the Bugbear clan."

Wu Qing's idea was to send out puppies lurking in various territories every day to detect the enemy's movements. When encountering small groups of enemy troops sweeping the territory, he would send troops to intercept them.

When encountering a large group of enemies, harass and delay them. Depending on the situation, you can decide whether to gather large forces to eliminate them, or to continue to engage in guerrilla warfare and war of attrition to buy time for each territory.

The native race has been able to compete with the foreign race for so many years, and there must be something special about it.

The leaders of this area, the Tengu clan, should not be underestimated. Wu Qing was jumping up and down to fight for opportunities for them. If they still failed to gain an advantage in this war, they deserved to be bullied by foreign races.

What Wu Qing wants is for both sides to maintain a relatively stable war situation, so that the Zerg will have more room for development.

Wu Qing still doesn't know which territories the main forces of the native races in this area are located and how far away they are. He needs more intelligence support.

In addition to the 16 territories discovered in the north of the Daxia Territory this time, the puppy also discovered several small territories in the west after continuous exploration. They are not much different from the original Red Territory Territory, with very poor development and a small population.

To the east of the Great Xia Territory, the puppy has never discovered the territory, nor has it discovered the city occupied by bugbears.

To the south of Daxia Territory is the Endless Mountain Range. Wu Qing only learned the name, but did not know the details. He also did not meet anyone who knew about this mountain range.

In this world, there is no way to stay out at night. Affected by this, the efficiency of the puppy's exploration and reconnaissance work outside is very low. It is thanks to these refugees that we can obtain so much territory information.

Otherwise, relying on puppies to find these territories will waste more time.

Wu Qing had this information about his surroundings, which was enough for the time being.

…

In terms of the development of the Zerg, there has been no increase in Zerg buildings. The number of worker bees has increased to 500 due to the needs of resource collection and new city construction.

Because the hydralisks' energy resources were converted into the luck of the Great Xia Territory, there was no qi available, so only 30 more hydralisks were added, bringing the total number of hydralisks to 450.

After two days of continuous violence, the number of puppies has exceeded 3,000. As the most basic combat unit of the Zerg, they perform the most extensive tasks and can be found everywhere.

After finding other territories, as long as there are a large number of people coming and going from these territories, Wu Qing will send puppies to follow him to find the location of more territories.

These puppies will become intelligence agents walking secretly in various territories, providing Wu Qing and the Zerg with all kinds of much-needed intelligence.

In the northeast of Daxia Territory, Wu Qing knew the only city that the bugbear clan had just captured. He sent his puppy there at dawn to monitor it, and found that more and more bugbear and lizardman armies were coming to gather.

Especially the lizardmen, the number is extremely huge.

Various materials were also being transported to the city.

"This city must have been used by the bear goblins as a forward base. This is really dangerous and an opportunity!"

"It looks both scary and tempting!"

Wu Qing was waiting for the bear goblins to make their move. If they were to gather a large army and go out together, they would definitely have to fight the main force of the native race. Wu Qing could follow behind and take advantage, and there was a lot of room for maneuver.

If a small force was to attack in a dispersed manner and conduct a sweep, the Zerg would have more opportunities to ensure that the bear goblins suffered heavy losses, and the losses were unclear.

No matter how the bear goblins made their decisions, he thought it was good as long as they didn't just stick to their posts.

Otherwise, Wu Qing, who couldn't bear it any longer, could only ambush the army that came to assemble.

Fortunately, Wu Qing didn't have to wait any longer. On the second day, the city sent a large number of scouts to scout the enemy.

These elite scouts of the bear goblins were experienced and quickly tracked down the territories of most of the native races based on the escape routes of the refugees.

Wu Qing's lurking dogs did not go out, allowing the locations of these territories to be exposed. He now intercepted and cleared the scouts of the bear goblin tribe, which was not very useful except for alerting the enemy.

It would be better to let these scouts take the intelligence back to paralyze the enemy and attract a small group of enemies to die.

Unless the enemy's entire city's army is dispatched, Wu Qing can fight with the Zerg.

Wu Qing followed these scouts and, relying on their experience, discovered some additional territories of local races, saving Wu Qing a lot of trouble.

The scouts rushed back to the city before dark and brought the intelligence back to the bear goblin tribe.

Wu Qing also ordered the dogs to return to various territories to continue lurking.
